bull_case_summary: Frontken has CFO increasing to RM62.623m and RM35.491m after capex despite receivable absorption. Round two separates this earned cash from warrant proceeds and argues bank-debt-free financing supports conditional Taiwan capacity utilisation.
bear_case_summary: The bear accepts fundability but stresses RM636.783m warrant funding, receivable absorption and other-income contributions. At 47.18x trailing earnings, utilisation and group growth must become stronger per-share cash after dilution.
key_points_of_agreement: Some liquidity is earned operating cash and some is external funding.
Bank-debt-free expansion is feasible, with leases separately relevant.
Operating demand is real while headline cash accumulation is not all operating wealth.
key_points_of_disagreement: Whether growth and funding capacity adequately compensate premium valuation, dilution and weaker conversion.
unresolved_uncertainties: Collections and per-share returns on new capacity.
Durability of earnings excluding other-income support; issuer report publication date not independently retrieved.
